name: side plank stretch crunch
description: A side-plank crunch that shortens and lengthens the upper side of the trunk while the supporting arm keeps the body lifted.
instructions: Set a side plank with one hand directly below the shoulder and your feet stacked or staggered.
Place your upper hand lightly behind your head and keep the hips lifted.
Curl the upper elbow toward the upper hip without twisting your support shoulder.
Lengthen the side of your trunk again, then repeat and switch sides.
